products.name: Cognigy
products.note: Conversational AI platform for customer service; GDPR-compliant; EU-hosted options

profile_text.body:
Cognigy is an enterprise software company focused on customer service automation, operating under the name NiCE Cognigy. The company describes itself as powering enterprise customer service with generative and conversational AI agents delivered across both voice and chat channels, with a stated emphasis on fast and personalized service in contact center environments.

Its core product is the Cognigy conversational AI platform, categorized as an enterprise AI platform and agent orchestration solution. The platform is noted as GDPR-compliant and available with EU-hosted deployment options, positioning it for organizations with data residency requirements. No litigation, patent filings, or MCP registry presence are recorded in the held facts for this company.
